items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.desc: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
items.note: 给 AI 代理加上跨会话记忆，自动记录每次操作、压缩后把相关上下文注入后续会话，兼容多种代理工具。
items.scene: 长期使用 AI 编程代理的开发者

items.title: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.desc: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
items.note: 把 Claude Code 改造成游戏开发工作室，内置 49 个 AI 代理和 72 项工作流技能，模拟真实团队分工。
